summary: Code review PASS. Change is minimal, surgical, and correct. The SUITE_ARG default flip from 'ledger' to 'all' mirrors the identical pattern used by the --target flag above it, making the two flags symmetric and easy to reason about. The info-note placement (after the suiteArgIdx check block) is idiomatic — console.log at the module-initialization phase before any suite expansion runs, so it fires exactly once per invocation. Header comment and inline comment are updated consistently. No dead code, no over-engineering, no regressions. Pre-commit hook correctness is a free bonus derived from the default change without any hook modification.

comments.note: Minor stylistic inconsistency: error messages use uppercase '[ERROR]' prefix while the new info message uses lowercase '[info]'. This is a common convention for severity-level differentiation (lowercase = informational, uppercase = error) and is not a bug, but documenting it here in case the project decides to formalize a log-prefix convention in the future.

No blocking issues found. The --suite and --target flag parsing blocks in build-personas.js are now structurally symmetric (both default to 'all', both have identical validation patterns), which improves long-term maintainability.
